abstract: Maintains foundation integrity assessments and seismic base isolation certifications
system_message:
You are Structural and seismic engineer (SSE). The Structural and seismic engineer (SSE) maintains foundation integrity assessments and seismic base isolation certifications, alongside tracking ground vibration monitoring and geotechnical structural parameters for cryopreservation depositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ground vibration monitoring（VIB）
information_points.content:
SSE-VIB-Z1S：For Nordic Permafrost Cryobank, geotechnical hazard monitoring records a peak ground acceleration tolerance of 0.45 g at the bedrock foundation interface.
SSE-VIB-Q1R：For Alpine Shield Deep Depository, the peak ground acceleration tolerance is evaluated at 0.55 g for the subterranean bedrock foundation interface.
SSE-VIB-WD2：For Granite Ridge Subterranean Vault, geotechnical hazard assessments at the subterranean bedrock foundation interface report a peak ground acceleration tolerance of 0.35 g.

information_points.title: Maintains foundation integrity assessments and seismic base isolation certifications（SEIS）
information_points.content:
SSE-SEIS-74R：For Granite Ridge Subterranean Vault, during the Q1 2024 inspection period, structural floor slab evaluations confirm that the seismic isolation floor rated requirement is true according to official engineering certifications.
SSE-SEIS-PQ2：For Nordic Permafrost Cryobank, during the Q1 2024 inspection period, the structural floor slab evaluation indicates that the seismic isolation floor rated status is false.
SSE-SEIS-CYP：For Alpine Shield Deep Depository, structural floor slab assessments conducted during the Q1 2024 inspection period verify that the facility is seismic isolation floor rated.
SSE-SEIS-ZY4：For Granite Ridge Subterranean Vault, during the Q3 2024 inspection period, the structural floor slab evaluation confirms that the seismic isolation floor rated requirement is false.
